assumptions.assumption: Physical resource identity must remain distinct from semantic program/decision/capability identities and stale handles must fail closed after resource drop/reallocation.
assumptions.ancestry: Prior Clay/FRANK/ClayCode foundry work already proposed distinct physical resource identity; this shared project ancestry is not counted as independent replication.
independent_evidence: WebAssembly Component Model runtime-managed typed resource handles with own/borrow lifetime rules
assumptions.refinement: Require opaque lifetime-checked resource identity at the Runtime ABI/FFI boundary; do not mandate generation tags in ClayCode source or core syntax.
assumptions.counterhypothesis: Backend-native opaque handles or non-reusing handle tables can satisfy the same stale-use invariant without explicit generation tags.
assumptions.falsifier: Production Ubuntu backend demonstrates that raw integer resource handles cannot resolve stale references after drop/reuse under exhaustive and fuzzed lifetime transitions, without hidden ambient authority or aliasing.
